cohort: The study included 74,639 subjects from the Japan Environment and Children's Study, derived from 104,065 fetal records and their children.
finding: Children born by cesarean delivery had no increased odds of developing wheezing, eczema, asthma, or atopic dermatitis by 1 year of age.
mod_finding: Children born by cesarean delivery had no increased odds of developing wheezing, eczema, asthma, or atopic dermatitis.
